quote: SLGAN is designed for sequence labeling tasks such as word segmentation, NER, and PoS tagging.
The predominant utilization of GANs in NLP has been confined to text generation tasks, including summarization, poetry generation, dialog systems, and machine translation.
outputs: SLGAN generates tag sequences for sequence labeling tasks such as word segmentation, named entity recognition, and part-of-speech tagging.

quote: Beyond the conventional Micro F1 score, we recognize the significance of the Out-of-Vocabulary (OOV) error as a crucial metric for assessing a word segmentation model's generalization capacity. Consequently, we introduce OOV recall (R_oov) to evaluate the generalization ability of SLGAN in the WS task. Furthermore, to ascertain the model's reliability and consistency, we monitor the Standard Deviation (SD) values across multiple experiments.
